name: Comet Chain
status: Gate 1 passed 2026-09-26 (owner picked R1 Comet Chain); brief written; building the upload-ready v1 on the merge-snake engine

notes.mouse-gesture: The comet follows mouse gestures in a top view, so CG-QUAL-008 applies: pointer lock + confinement during a round (requested on the PLAY click), a custom cursor ring, unlock on P / Tab / the browser's native Escape (never bound by the game), a pause overlay on unlock, pause and mute reachable by keyboard (P, M). Fallback when the lock is refused: unlocked mouse-follow with pointer capture and the same cursor ring.
notes.multiplayer: Single-player 'Offline Arena' against 12 bots. The mode label is shown wherever bot names appear (home, HUD, leaderboard slice, kill feed, podium); bots are never presented as real players. Owner decision 2026-09-26: no per-name BOT tag.
notes.banners: None in v1: menus are open under 5 s on average between 90 s rounds, and banners are off in the CrazyGames app and Basic Launch. Re-evaluate for the shop after launch data.
notes.has-progress: Coins, upgrades (Start size, Magnet, Boost tank), skins owned/tried, arena tier, best rank, biggest world, offer timestamps, daily gift day/streak and mute, saved via the CrazyGames Data module.
notes.has-accounts: No in-game accounts; guests play, and the Data module migrates guest progress on CrazyGames login.
notes.keyboard: WASD / arrows (KeyboardEvent.code) steer, Space / ShiftLeft boost, P pause, Tab release pointer, M mute. Escape and Ctrl combos are never bound.
notes.rewarded: 7 surfaces, each with a cap and a coin or play path: Start bigger, Keep your chain (once per session), Claim x3, shop cash, free upgrade, try a skin, daily gift x2 (docs/GAME_BRIEF.md).
notes.budgets: Profile M (skill references/threejs/visual-style.md). Enforced by tools/qa/browser-qa.mjs (poly-budget, dead-air) and tools/qa/check-poly.mjs. heroTriangles: at most ONE geometry may exceed trianglesPerGeometry, up to this. Raise a budget only with a written reason in docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md.
